lines.text: Though Jesus had performed many signs in their presence, the people did not believe in Him, as Isaiah had said.
Isaiah said these things because he saw the glory of Moses and spoke about him.
Many leaders believed in Him but did not confess Him, fearing they would be put out of the synagogue.
Jesus said He came as a light, not to judge the world but to rule the world.
Jesus said the word He has spoken will judge the one who rejects Him on the last day.
